description: Gets Cognigy.AI conversation counter metrics for one month. Returns aggregated conversation counts for a project or the entire organization.

month.description: Month to report on (1-12). Defaults to the current month.

projectId.description: Project ID for project-level metrics. Omit for organization-wide metrics.

year.description: Year to report on (e.g., 2026). Defaults to the current year.

name: get_conversation_metrics
